description:

Serviced Apartment - A piece of home for a few months? 

smartments is a professionally managed serviced apartment house.

Whether you are traveling for work, traveling or just need a nice place to stay for a long time: In our fully and smartly furnished apartments you get high-quality furnishings and individual service. 

The studio is 21sqm and has a cozy double bed (1.40 mx 2.00 m) and a kitchenette. 
The modern kitchenette is fully equipped with: refrigerator, dishwasher, 2 hobs, microwave, extractor fan: everything in it! Dishes, glasses, bowls, pots and cooking utensils are also included so that you can always serve something delicious yourself. 
The apartment is modernly furnished with furniture that impresses with details: beautiful fabrics and materials, pleasant surfaces, comfortable furnishings. Weekly cleaning incl.

--------------------
*Uncomplicated CheckIn on the day of arrival*.

1 week before arrival you will receive an email with further information for the day of arrival as well as instructions for using the `Hotelbird` app and the checkin kiosk.

1)	Do you already use the free app "Hotelbird" for PreCheckIn and room card?

Through the app, you use your phone as a key and can no longer lose it.

For the use of the app you need to activate the Bluetooth function!!

2)	You want to check in on site first?

Our checkin-kiosk is also available around the clock.
Have your booking number and last name of the booking ready and follow the instructions on the screen.

++Please note that you can only create your room card via app or checkin-kiosk after 2 pm.++

--------------------
We are available for you by phone around the clock. If you would like to speak to a member of staff on site, please refer to the notices at the reception desk in the building.

For longer-staying guests, we offer housekeeping service, which will be provided every week at no charge.

Please note that the displayed images are sample images and may differ from the booked studios.

--------------------
At the accommodation you have the possibility to rent a parking space. The parking space is chargeable and only available on request. Please contact the house before arrival.

title: Friedrich-Ebert-Straße, Mannheim
description:
Hello there,

We offer three separate rooms in a updated, fully furnished 3-room apartment in a central location in Mannheim that works especially well for international exchange students and young professionals visiting Mannheim for studies, internships or full-time trial periods. Of course everyone else is also welcome.

You can move in directly as each room is fully furnished and equipped with a high-quality bed, as well as a work desk with office chair, a neat drawer and wardrobe for storage space and a leather armchair to chill and read. In addition, a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom are at your disposal for common use with the two co-tenants. There is a dedicated washing room in the basement with a washing machine for the apartment. All communication as well as your rental contract will be in English to make things easy for you. We also speak English, German, Spanish, French and Arabic in case helpful. Finally, for best convenience, electricity, heating, and ultra-high-speed internet are all included in a flat fee - you will not have to deal with separate (German) utility contracts at all! 

We also welcome requests from a group that already knows each other for the three rooms altogether.

Location

The apartment is located very close to the city center, directly on the border between the districts Neckarstadt-Ost and Wohlgelegen in Friedrich-Ebert-Straße 42a on the 1st floor. A train stop is right outside the front door (Stop - Bonifatiuskirche), tram lines 5 and 4 stop here and you can reach the city center (Stop – Wasserturm) in 10 minutes and the university (Stop – Schloss) in 15 minutes. Directly across the street are green spaces for strolling around or going for a run incl. the popular Herzogenriedpark, which features a flower garden, mini-zoo, water features and other attractions. Supermarkets, coffee places, restaurants, pharmacies and the university clinic are located in the immediate vicinity of the apartment.

Facilities

All three rooms are similar in size (c. 20 sqm / c. 215 sq. feet) and one room even has a small balcony. Each room is fully furnished and equipped with a high-quality bed incl. new blanket & pillow, a work desk with a comfortable office chair for the occasional longer study (or gaming?) night, a neat drawer and wardrobe for sufficient storage space and a premium leather armchair to chill and read. In addition, a fully equipped kitchen incl. a ‘lounge setup’ is available for everyone to spend time together or have guests over. In case you value privacy, each room can be locked as well.

Rent

The three rooms are rented at a worry-free flat fee per month, including all utilities (heating, electricity, water and ultra-high-speed internet). This is very uncommon for the quite complex German Rental Market which typically sees tenants having to sign various lengthy contracts with utility providers oftentimes with unexpected supplement payments. You will experience none of this as we aimed to build the most convenient package for you for the smoothest possible start in Mannheim.

We are looking forward to hosting you so please do not hesitate to get in touch!
